digits_selection.description: Sequential data selection on the digits dataset using the paper's RQ3 protocol.

mean_accuracy.description: Average test accuracy over the full sequential selection curve.

mean_accuracy_std.description: Run-to-run variability of full-curve test accuracy across seeds.

early10_accuracy.description: Mean test accuracy over the first 10 selected examples, emphasizing very low-budget selection.

early20_accuracy.description: Mean test accuracy over the first 20 selected examples, measuring sample-efficient early ranking quality.

tail_accuracy.description: Mean test accuracy after the early-selection region, checking that early gains persist across larger budgets.

worst_prefix_accuracy.description: Lowest test accuracy reached by any prefix of the ranking, penalizing fragile curves.

max_accuracy_drop.description: Largest one-step decrease in test accuracy along the selection curve.

early_label_balance.description: Normalized label entropy in the first 20 selected examples, discouraging degenerate early class composition.
